bio.text: Jessica Ethridge is the Libertarian candidate for South Carolina's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.

According to her Libertarian Party candidate profile, she grew up in Greer, has lived in the Upstate all her life, and has worked as a legal professional for almost 20 years, most recently in the title insurance industry.
She was the Libertarian candidate for lieutenant governor in 2022, on a ticket with gubernatorial candidate Bruce Reeves.
The profile says she has served as Greenville County Libertarian Party secretary and chair and as second vice chair of the state party.

sources.title: Lt. Governor candidate Jessica Ethridge wins national endorsements
